WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, status,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
l AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, w.dispatch_date, f.gross_amount, f.net_amount, f.sale_date
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, count(*) AS n_lines, count(DISTINCT l.sales_line_id) AS n_distinct, sum(l.gross_amount) AS gross, sum(l.net_amount) AS net
FROM l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=l.dispatch_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter=2
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2

WITH wo AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, status, order_total_gross, line_count,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dd
  FROM fact_web_order
),
ln AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT f.line_no) AS nl, sum(f.gross_amount) AS g,
         min(s.store_id) AS smin, max(s.store_id) AS smax, max(f.channel_code) AS cc
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM wo)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT d.fiscal_period, wo.status,
  count(*) AS orders,
  sum(CASE WHEN ln.receipt_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_lines,
  sum(CASE WHEN ln.n<>ln.nl THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dup_lineno,
  sum(CASE WHEN ln.n<>wo.line_count THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linecount_mismatch,
  sum(CASE WHEN abs(ln.g-wo.order_total_gross)>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_mismatch,
  sum(CASE WHEN ln.smin<>900 OR ln.smax<>900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non900,
  sum(CASE WHEN ln.cc<>'WB' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS notWB
FROM wo LEFT JOIN ln ON ln.receipt_id=wo.web_order_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=wo.dd
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter=2
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dd
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
)
SELECT d.fiscal_period, p.category='ZZ Test' AS is_test, f.vat_rate, p.vat_class,
  count(*) AS n, sum(f.gross_amount) AS gross, sum(f.net_amount) AS net,
  sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vat_inconsistent,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.net_amount<=0 OR f.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpositive
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=w.dd
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter=2
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dd
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
mine AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_period, sum(f.net_amount) AS net
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=w.dd
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter=2
  GROUP BY 1
),
ctl AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_period, sum(r.net_sales_before_returns) AS ctl_net
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
  WHERE r.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter=2
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT m.fiscal_period, m.net, c.ctl_net, m.net-c.ctl_net AS diff FROM mine m JOIN ctl c USING (fiscal_period) ORDER BY 1
